BiblicalUsage: Nekoda is a family of temple servants who come back from exile, named in the return lists of both Ezra and Nehemiah. One branch of the family cannot prove its descent when the records are searched, yet the name is still written down among those who returned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lists are merciful: even a family whose papers are missing is named among the ones who came home.
